description: This is a test source file for the Command class within the org.eclipse.hono.client package. It contains unit tests verifying the creation and behavior of Command objects from AMQP messages, including parsing reply-to addresses, handling application properties, and encoding reply-to options.

classes.name: CommandTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the Command class, including message parsing, reply-to address handling, and reply-to options encoding/decoding.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceeds
methods.description: Tests creating a Command from a message with a typical reply-to address, verifying all properties including replyToId and command message.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithoutDeviceId
methods.description: Tests creating a Command from a message with a reply-to address lacking a device ID, ensuring proper replyToId and address formatting.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithDeviceId
methods.description: Tests creating a Command where reply-to address includes a device ID, verifying correct replyToId and endpoint.

methods.name: testForReplyToWithLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Tests creating a Command using the legacy reply-to endpoint, validating replyTo endpoint and addresses.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithoutReplyTo
methods.description: Verifies creating a Command from a message with null reply-to, expecting one-way command and null replyToId.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithoutReplyToAndCorrelationId
methods.description: Verifies creation when message lacks reply-to and correlation ID, expecting one-way command.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithMessageIdButNoCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests handling of message with message ID but no correlation ID, ensuring correctness.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithApplicationProperties
methods.description: Checks extraction of application properties from message, verifying correct retrieval.

methods.name: testFromMessageSucceedsWithNoApplicationProperties
methods.description: Verifies behavior when application properties are absent in message.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMissingCorrelationOrMessageId
methods.description: Ensures invalid Command creation when both correlation or message ID are missing.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMalformedReplyToAddress
methods.description: Verifies failure when reply-to address is malformed.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForNonMatchingReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks that reply-to address not matching the target device results in invalid Command.

methods.name: testGetInvalidCommandReason
methods.description: Validates the string returned from getInvalidCommandReason() includes details about missing fields.

methods.name: testEncodeDecodeReplyToOptions
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of reply-to options bit flags, verifying correct interpretation of options.
